entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Main branch net11.0 transition status tracking #50295
  • [NETE2ESDK] [Windows] Error NU1102 is displayed when creating .NET 10 console app #50286
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #50284
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #50278
  • show god old Build success message #50276

Closed

  • [Static Web Assets] Avoid adding an additional weak ETag to compressed assets #50290

PullRequests

Created

  • Make duplicate deb/rpm packages so we can sign them with the new PMC key #50294
    Servicing-consider, Area-Infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #50293

    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add PostAction for dotnet.config #50285
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Avoid copying http-client.env.json to the output folder #50280
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50274
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-CodeFlow

Merged

  • [Static Web Assets] Remove weak ETag generation for compressed assets #50291
  • [Static web assets] Add support for filtering the final list of endpoints #50292
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add README.md to NetAnalyzers and CODEOWNERS entry #50288

    Servicing-approved

  • Move Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers from roslyn-analyzers into sdk #50167
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Avoid unnecessary evaluations during `dotnet run file.cs` #49991
    Area-run-file
  • Fix inconsistent `tool exec` help #50238
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2772484 #50273
